title: Software Engineering Intern
description_raw:
Software Engineering Intern (Fall 2026)

Gemini is a global crypto exchange and custodian. We are looking for interns to join our engineering team for Fall 2026.

Responsibilities:
- Build features for our trading platform
- Collaborate with product and design

Requirements:
- Currently pursuing a BS or MS in Computer Science or related field
- Strong programming skills in Python or TypeScript

Preferred:
- Experience with distributed systems

Compensation: $45–55/hr. Locations: New York, NY; Remote (US).
